drivingQuestion: How can Rabban Gamliel say 'and not only this did they say' when he himself does not hold 'until midnight'?
outcomeNote: The mishna's formulation is reinterpreted as Rabban Gamliel speaking to the Rabbis' view

segments.he: וְרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל מִי קָאָמַר ״עַד חֲצוֹת״ דְּקָתָנֵי ״וְלֹא זוֹ בִּלְבַד אָמְרוּ״?
segments.en: The Gemara questions the formulation of the mishna: «Does Rabban Gamliel say until midnight, that he teaches: And not only did they say?» Rabban Gamliel does not restrict the time for the recitation of Shema until midnight, so why does he say, and not only do they say, implying that he agrees with that stringency?

segments.he: הָכִי קָאָמַר לְהוּ רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל לִבְנֵיהּ: אֲפִילּוּ לְרַבָּנַן דְּקָאָמְרִי ״עַד חֲצוֹת״, מִצְוָתָהּ עַד שֶׁיַּעֲלֶה עַמּוּד הַשַּׁחַר. וְהַאי דְּקָא אָמְרִי עַד חֲצוֹת — כְּדֵי לְהַרְחִיק אָדָם מִן הָעֲבֵירָה.
segments.en: The Gemara explains that «this is what Rabban Gamliel said to his sons: Even according to the Rabbis, who say» that the mitzva may be performed only «until midnight,» the biblical obligation to perform «the mitzva» continues «until dawn, and that which they say» that it may only be recited «until midnight» is «in order to distance a person from transgression.»

moves.summary: Rabban Gamliel does not hold until midnight, so why 'and not only this did they say'?
moves.about: Rabban Gamliel does not hold 'until midnight', so why does the mishna have him say 'and not only this did they say'

moves.cueHe: הכי קאמר להו רבן גמליאל לבניה
moves.summary: he meant: even for the Rabbis the mitzva lasts until dawn, and their midnight is a fence
moves.about: Rabban Gamliel meant: even for the Rabbis who say until midnight, the mitzva lasts until dawn

edges.cueHe: ורבן גמליאל מי קאמר עד חצות דקתני ולא זו בלבד אמרו?
edges.about: Rabban Gamliel does not hold 'until midnight', so why does the mishna have him say 'and not only this did they say'

edges.cueHe: הכי קאמר להו רבן גמליאל לבניה
edges.about: Rabban Gamliel meant: even for the Rabbis who say until midnight, the mitzva lasts until dawn

edges.cueHe: אפילו לרבנן דקאמרי עד חצות, מצותה עד שיעלה עמוד השחר
edges.about: even the Rabbis who say until midnight hold that the mitzva itself lasts until dawn

edges.cueHe: והאי דקא אמרי עד חצות — כדי להרחיק אדם מן העבירה
edges.about: the Rabbis' 'until midnight' is a fence to distance a person from transgression

extras.cueHe: אפילו לרבנן דקאמרי עד חצות, מצותה עד שיעלה עמוד השחר
extras.about: even the Rabbis who say until midnight hold that the mitzva itself lasts until dawn
